notes: Water guns aimed at slush blops on the bank is PvE target shooting, and the genre notes call a rail or gallery shooter an Aim Trainer that moves the camera - so I kept that preset but swapped its range-directed shape for route-guided from the wider catalogue, since the current sequences the player past the targets instead of anchoring them at a fixed firing line. Party & Casual is named second for the scored round with friends, which is where trigger-scoring comes from for both the per-blop score and the downstream round end; it was a close call which of the two leads. The river itself is water-body, and that is the only modifier here - CHECK, which should clear, because the float happens on one flat water surface that cannot self-occlude. Decided without a user: I did not flag SET, because unlike a fixed booth the player really does travel the length of the map and the channel needs to stay traversable; station-loadout became a water-gun rack at the put-in so the float has a defined start, and the guided route's downstream terminus is the place the run ends.
